name: 1bb-connect
description: Connect your own 1BB account to Claude Desktop. Read your goals, training, Voice DNA and shared sources, and save drafts to your 1BB Library.
long_description: 1BB Connect lets Claude read the parts of your 1BB account you chose to share when you made your connection key: your business brief, goals, training, Voice DNA and Second Brain sources. Claude can save drafts to your 1BB Library and prepare a post for your review. Claude can never approve or publish. You approve every post inside 1BB. Keys last 7 days. Make a new one in 1BB Settings, then Connect, and paste it into this extension's settings.

connection_token.title: 1BB connection key
connection_token.description: Create it in 1BB: Settings, then Connect. It starts with 1bbct_ and lasts 7 days. It is stored in your computer's secure keychain. Never paste it into a chat.

tools.name: onebb_connection_status
tools.description: Check connection permissions, expiry and available tools.

tools.name: onebb_get_voice_rules
tools.description: Read a safe summary of your Voice DNA rules.

tools.name: onebb_get_training
tools.description: Read one training module and your watch state.

tools.name: onebb_search_sources
tools.description: Search the Second Brain sources you chose to share.

tools.name: onebb_get_source
tools.description: Read one shared source with citation details.

tools.name: onebb_get_content
tools.description: Read one Library draft and its version.

tools.name: onebb_save_draft

tools.name: onebb_prepare_publish
